scribe.settings.title: Scribe Settings
scribe.settings.presets.tooltip: Sets your own switches for how you use Scribe: Writer, Reader or Vanilla-like. The world's switches stay as they are.
scribe.presets.title: Presets
scribe.presets.writer.tooltip: All on: the editor's helpers (format marks, local backups, line up frames, chapter headers), book covers and the cover designer, book colours and icons, books in the world.
scribe.presets.reader.tooltip: Reading first: book covers, colours and icons, books in the world, look-at tooltips and the page you were on. The editor's format marks, frames, saved message and the cover designer are off.
scribe.presets.vanilla.tooltip: Only Scribe's book screens: no covers, colours, icons or books in the world, no enchanted book reader, and the editor's extras off. Local backups stay on.
scribe.settings.writing_only.tooltip: Turns off Book personalisation and Books in the world, also in worlds you host. Off: everything comes back.
scribe.settings.writing_utilities.toolti: Scribe's book screens and its tools for books and signs. Off turns them all off, also in worlds you host. Your choices are kept. /books settings opens these settings again.
scribe.settings.personalization.tooltip: Covers, colours, icons and bindings. Off turns them all off, also in worlds you host. Your choices are kept.
scribe.settings.world_books.tooltip: Lecterns, shelves, placed books, reading poses and look-at tooltips. Off turns them all off, also in worlds you host. Your choices are kept.
scribe.settings.replace_editor.tooltip: Use Scribe's editor when you open a book and quill. Hold Shift while opening a book to get the vanilla screen.
scribe.settings.replace_reader.tooltip: Use Scribe's reader for written books.
scribe.settings.layout.tooltip: Auto shows two pages side by side when the window is wide enough.
scribe.settings.tint.tooltip: Colour the cover in the book screens with the book's dye.
scribe.settings.engraved.tooltip: Cover text looks cut into the leather. Off: printed in a light tone, which some find easier to read.
scribe.settings.running_header.tooltip: In a book with chapter titles (the H button), the current chapter shows in small letters at the top of each page.
scribe.settings.covers.tooltip: Books open at their cover the first time. Turn back from the first page to close them.
scribe.settings.cover_designer.tooltip: Adds a panel to the Sign screen for the title colour, decoration, spine, metalwork and corners.
scribe.settings.item_icons.tooltip: Book icons show their colour and binding, and enchanted books their style. Off: Minecraft's icons.
scribe.settings.lectern_look.tooltip: Books on lecterns and books held open show their colour and binding. Off: Minecraft's book.
scribe.settings.closed_books.tooltip: Closed books on lecterns look closed. Off: every lectern book looks open.
scribe.settings.table_look.tooltip: Enchanting table books show the table's colour. A table named jeb_ cycles through all colours.
scribe.settings.shelf_colors.tooltip: Chiselled bookshelves show each book's colour, and enchanted books shine.
scribe.settings.neutral_glint.tooltip: Signed books shine in white instead of purple, so their colour stays visible.
scribe.settings.enchanted_reader.tooltip: Right-click an enchanted book in your hand to read its enchantments. Works on any server. Hold Shift or sneak to skip it.
scribe.settings.escape.tooltip: What Escape does when the book has unsaved changes.
scribe.settings.saved_message.tooltip: Show "Book saved" after closing a book you changed.
scribe.settings.overflow.tooltip: Flows on: extra text moves into the next pages. New page: it goes to a new page and the others stay as they are.
scribe.settings.paste_codes.tooltip: Keep section-sign formatting codes when pasting text.
scribe.settings.section_key.tooltip: Tap this key alone to type the section sign, which starts codes like bold or colours. Holding it still types accents.
scribe.settings.marks.tooltip: Small marks under the text where formatting codes are hidden.
scribe.settings.editor_start.tooltip: Which page a book and quill opens on.
scribe.settings.backups.tooltip: Every save also keeps a copy in scribe/backups, in your Minecraft folder.
scribe.settings.frames.tooltip: Keeps the right border of frames like ┌─┐ lined up as you write, also for players without Scribe.
scribe.settings.scroll.tooltip: Hold %1$s to turn pages %3$s at a time, Shift to turn slowly.
scribe.settings.fast_scroll.tooltip: Hold %1$s to turn pages %3$s at a time with the wheel, %4$s with two pages showing.
scribe.settings.invert_scroll.tooltip: Wheel up goes forward instead of back.
scribe.settings.remember.tooltip: Books reopen on the page where you stopped reading.
scribe.settings.bookmarks.tooltip: When you close a book on a server with Scribe, the server learns its page, so a lectern opens the book there.
scribe.settings.look_at.tooltip: Look at a lectern, shelf or placed book to see what it holds. Sneak to see every line. Most need Scribe on the server.
scribe.settings.look_lecterns.tooltip: Shows a lectern book's title, author and page, or its enchantments. Needs Scribe on the server.
scribe.settings.look_chiseled.tooltip: Shows the book you look at in a chiselled bookshelf. Needs Scribe on the server.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.scribe: Write, read and keep books comfortably, and they stay vanilla books: players without Scribe can still read them and join. Pages that flow, a formatting bar, chapters, bookmarks, symbols, undo, files and backups; covers you design when signing, pen names, bindings and colours; books on lecterns, shelves and blocks, and ink pots.
scribe.guide.title: Scribe Guide
scribe.guide.subtitle: Writing, reading and keeping books
scribe.guide.welcome.1: Scribe makes books easy to write and a pleasure to read. They stay normal books, so players without Scribe can read them too.
scribe.guide.welcome.2: Right-click a **Book and Quill** to write, or a written book to read. The **Index** cell lists this guide's chapters.
scribe.guide.writing.1: Type or paste: the text flows on to the next pages. A page break you make stays where you put it.
scribe.guide.writing.2: The bar above the book formats text: **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, ~~strikethrough~~, colours, alignment, chapter titles and symbols.
scribe.guide.writing.3: The cells beside the book save, load, copy, paste and clear the whole book. Under each page: add, delete and more page tools.
scribe.guide.writing.4: **Done** saves and closes. Every save also keeps a backup in `scribe/backups`.
scribe.guide.chapters.1: **H** makes a line a chapter title, listed in the index. A contents page lists your chapters; in a signed book each line takes you there.
scribe.guide.chapters.2: Click the bookmark at the top of a page to mark it. Bookmarks are yours alone, kept on your computer.
scribe.guide.signing.1: **Sign** opens the cover designer: title, subtitle, pen name and the cover's look. **Save details** keeps them until you sign.
scribe.guide.signing.2: A signed book opens at its cover. Its author can change it later with `/books cover edit`.
scribe.guide.files.1: The save cell writes the book to `scribe/books`: a book file, text, Markdown, a PDF or page pictures. Only your own books.
scribe.guide.files.2: The load cell fills a **Book and Quill** from a file; in text, a line of --- starts a new page. You can also drop a file onto the book.
scribe.guide.world.1: Lectern books lie closed until read: __sneak__ and right-click with an empty hand to open or close one. A **Book and Quill** on a lectern is written right there, one writer at a time.
scribe.guide.world.2: __Sneak__ and right-click the top of a block with a book to lay it in a pile, or a side to stand it in a row. Right-click it with another item to drop it.
scribe.guide.world.3: Chiselled bookshelves show their books' colours. A dye colours an enchanting table's book, a **Water Bottle** washes it. Look at a lectern, shelf or placed book to see what it holds.
scribe.guide.ink.1: A **Water Bottle** and a dye make an ink pot. Right-click a block to set it down, up to four in one space.
scribe.guide.ink.2: Right-click a pot with a **Feather** to add a quill. Ink, a **Book** and a **Feather** make a **Book and Quill**.
scribe.guide.binding.1: Dye a book in the crafting grid; a cauldron washes it. Only a written book's author, or an admin, can change its colours.
scribe.guide.binding.2: At the smithing table, leather adds a strap: with a dye it is coloured, with a trim material it gets a metal buckle. A trim material alone adds corners; a grindstone takes it all off.
scribe.guide.enchanted.1: Right-click an enchanted book in your hand to read its enchantments. Hold __Shift__ or __sneak__ to skip it.
scribe.guide.commands.files: `/books export`, `import`, `list` and `folder`: save, load and find your files.
scribe.guide.commands.cover: `/books cover`: see or change the cover of the book in your hand.
scribe.guide.commands.pose: `/books pose`: hold your book open; type it again or press __Escape__ to stop.
scribe.guide.commands.settings: `/books settings`: Scribe's settings, also while its book screens are off.
scribe.guide.commands.author: `/scribe author`: who really wrote a book. For admins.
scribe.guide.commands.book: `/scribe book`: books from data packs and where they are found. For admins.
scribe.guide.settings.1: The gear at the top right of a book screen opens the settings. **Presets** set many at once; the Controls have keys for this guide, the settings and the pose.
scribe.guide.settings.world: World settings follow: they apply to the worlds you host. A server with Scribe decides its own.
